selection_process: First preference Represented the country in an International Competition, with clearance of the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

Second preference Represented a State/UT in Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by recognized National Sports Federations, or National Games organized by the Indian Olympics Association, with a medal or position up to 3rd place (Senior National medal winners preferred over Junior National participants)

Third preference Represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by the Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board, or Khelo India University Games, with a medal or position up to 3rd place in finals

Fourth preference Represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years), Khelo India Winter Games, or Khelo India Para Games, with a medal or position up to 3rd place in finals
Fifth preference Represented the State Schools in National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation, with a medal or position up to 3rd place
Sixth preference Represented a State/UT/University/State Schools team at the levels mentioned in categories (B) to (E) above, but did not win a medal or position, in the same order of preference

how_to_apply: Go through the notification, instructions to candidates, and vacancy positions carefully before filling up the application form.

Submit the application online from 15.08.2026 till the last date, 15.09.2026, using the link on the notification/advertisement uploaded at https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/pune/news-updates, or directly at https://www.itsportsrecruitmentpune.com.
Upload all relevant/necessary documents along with the application form.
Indicate the post(s) being applied for clearly in the "Post applied for" column, with your order of preference (first preference, second preference, and so on) if applying for more than one post.
Select the relevant games/sports if you wish to be considered under more than one game/sport, within the same single application.
Upload the SC/ST caste certificate in the prescribed form, if claiming such relaxation.
Pay the application fee of ₹200 through online mode and attach proof of payment with the application.

Submit the application before the last date, 15.09.2026. Only one application is permitted per candidate - submitting more than one application will lead to summary rejection of all such applications.
important_instructions: The notification is signed by Manish Kumar Singh, IRS, Commissioner of Income Tax (Admin. & TPS), Pune, Office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Pune.

content_sections.text: Sports achievements/participation of candidates will be considered only up to the date of this notification, i.e. 10.08.2026. Any sports achievement obtained after this date will not be considered for recruitment under the sports quota.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Department Pune Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The total number of posts across all three cadres is 85. A candidate can apply for any one or more than one of the above posts in a single application, indicating their order of preference.

content_sections.heading: List of Sports/Games for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from meritorious sportspersons belonging to the following 17 sports/games. The table also shows the number of posts allocated by sport and gender.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. The candidate must belong to one of the 17 recognized sports/games listed above and must be able to produce a self-attested certificate of eligibility (Form-1, 2, 3, 4, or 5, as applicable) from a competent authority. A candidate who cannot produce at least one such certificate along with the application need not apply. The candidate must fulfil the essential educational qualification and age limit prescribed for the post applied for.

rows.essential_educational_other_qualificatio: 12th class pass or equivalent from a recognized Board or University

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026 Selection Criteria
content_sections.text: Meritorious sportspersons will be selected as per the order of preference prescribed by the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT) OM No. 14034/1/95-Estt.(D) dated 04.05.1995, read with DoPT OM No. 1720781414772 dated 04.03.2024. In the event of a tie, candidates who secured a higher position or won more than one medal may be given preference. Participation in an individual event and a team event/item may be given the same preference. No additional preference is given for winning more than one medal/position. Any doubt about the status of a tournament will be decided by the DoPT in consultation with the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

rows.preference_criteria: Represented the country in an International Competition, with clearance of the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

Represented a State/UT in Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by recognized National Sports Federations, or National Games organized by the Indian Olympics Association, with a medal or position up to 3rd place (Senior National medal winners preferred over Junior National participants)

Represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by the Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board, or Khelo India University Games, with a medal or position up to 3rd place in finals
Represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years), Khelo India Winter Games, or Khelo India Para Games, with a medal or position up to 3rd place in finals
Represented the State Schools in National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation, with a medal or position up to 3rd place
Represented a State/UT/University/State Schools team at the levels mentioned in categories (B) to (E) above, but did not win a medal or position, in the same order of preference

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: As per Government of India instructions for meritorious sportspersons, relaxation of the upper age limit up to a maximum of 5 years (10 years in the case of SC/ST candidates) may be allowed. This relaxation is admissible only to sportspersons who satisfy all other eligibility conditions related to education and sports qualifications, and who furnish a certificate in the prescribed form from a prescribed authority. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

Applications received without payment of the requisite fee will be treated as INCOMPLETE and rejected. The fee, once paid, shall not be refunded under any circumstances. The notification does not mention any fee exemption or concession for any category of candidates.

Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload self-attested copies of the following documents along with the application form, as per requirement: Matriculation/SSC or equivalent certificate/Birth Certificate/Aadhar Card/Passport, for proof of age Educational Qualification Certificates Caste/Community Certificate, in support of a reservation claim Sports/Games Certificates Certificate of Eligibility for Recruitment of Sportsperson (Form-1, 2, 3, 4, or 5, as applicable) Certificate of PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) and UDID card, if applicable NOC from the present employer, if the candidate is already employed in a Central/State Government department, organization, or PSU Copy of Aadhar Card Copy of a recent passport-size photograph A declaration of no pending investigation against the candidate regarding doping or use of unfair means to compete or win in any sporting event

faq.question: Q1. What is Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification from the Office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Pune Region, inviting applications from meritorious sportspersons for direct recruitment to 85 posts of Stenographer Grade-II, Tax Assistant, and Multi-Tasking Staff, under the sports quota.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 85 vacancies in total: 6 Stenographer Grade-II, 40 Tax Assistant, and 39 Multi-Tasking Staff posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of applications is 15.09.2026. Online applications open on 15.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 12th class pass or equivalent for Stenographer Grade-II, a Degree from a recognized university or equivalent for Tax Assistant, and Matriculation or equivalent pass for Multi-Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01.01.2026, the age limit is 18–27 years for Stenographer Grade-II and Tax Assistant, and 18–25 years for Multi-Tasking Staff, with age relaxation up to 5 years (10 years for SC/ST) admissible for meritorious sportspersons.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹200, payable online only. Applications without proof of fee payment will be treated as incomplete and rejected, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible sportspersons can apply online via https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/pune/news-updates or directly at https://www.itsportsrecruitmentpune.com, uploading all required documents and the sports eligibility certificate (Form-1 to Form-5, as applicable) between 15.08.2026 and 15.09.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection follows a six-level DoPT order of preference based on the level of sporting achievement (International, National, Inter-University, Khelo India, School National, and participation-only categories), followed by post-specific skill tests, medical fitness, and police verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Stenographer Grade-II and Tax Assistant carry Level 4 pay (₹25,500–₹81,100), and Multi-Tasking Staff carries Level 1 pay (₹18,000–₹56,900), as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q10. Which sports are eligible for Income Tax Department Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are invited from 17 recognized sports/games: Athletics, Badminton, Basketball, Boxing, Bridge, Carrom, Chess, Cricket, Hockey, Kabaddi, Parasports, Swimming, Table Tennis, Tennis, Volleyball, Wrestling, and Yogasana.
